critical_journeys.claim: User can build/freeze a campaign plan, start the exact server-revalidated digest, reconnect to persisted progress and inspect candidate runs plus compatibility/decision policy.
residual_gaps: bounded request-level parameter sweeps when a runtime exposes explicit search ranges

critical_journeys.claim: User configures a model, reviews frozen preflight, launches evaluation, observes progress and reopens the immutable result.
User can find tested-model evidence with workload and device context without an unsupported opaque winner claim.
User can compare compatible evidence and see only valid quality/runtime/resource trade-off deltas.
An incompatible comparison explains why deltas are invalid and suppresses misleading metric deltas.
A failed run exposes an actionable cause and the user can retry successfully without stale run ownership.
Cancelling a run releases owned resources before a subsequent evaluation can start and complete.
User can inspect a benchmark definition and understand cases, prompt/input, expected output and evaluator/scoring rules without confusing definition data with execution results.
User can inspect an immutable run and its sample/evaluator evidence, including explicit content-not-retained states for aggregate-safe evidence.
User can compare one benchmark case across compatible model/quantization/configuration runs without invalid cross-protocol conclusions.
Performance Lab retains truthful model/runtime/device identity and runtime/resource evidence against a real external Local LLM Server on representative hardware.
residual_gaps: real model/runtime identity and effective backend behavior
